identity: Personal local-first mobile intelligence and action environment
constraints: local-first and on-device AI as default
native UI; no HTML-based Locco app or web dashboard
native browser may render remote websites
optional external providers require user configuration and consent
future iOS shell sharing Rust contracts

acquisition: persistent and private browser profiles with account/session continuity
intelligence: structured DOM observations with page/frame provenance
DOM Stitching across nodes, repeated records and pages
semantic schema/field/locator proposals with deterministic validation
reasoning: replaceable local models across supported tasks and modalities
model/runtime selection under privacy and device budgets
execution: generic capability compiler and execution graph
reusable procedures, tools, data bindings, constraints and evaluators
workspace: fast intent, voice, share and file capture
searchable records, entities and evidence inspection
native browser and contextual DOM inspection

donor_repositories.outbound_sourcer: source adapter and discovery pipeline concepts; not product identity
donor_repositories.ebo: event/signal ledger, qualification and approval concepts; no infrastructure dependency
donor_repositories.bos: entity/capability/workflow/policy modeling; not a business OS shell
donor_repositories.troy: source-aware extraction, interpretation and identity resolution
donor_repositories.me: immutable evidence and derived observation concepts; no personal DB import
donor_repositories.memo: selected Android automation, approval and visible-browser patterns; not base product
donor_repositories.busybee: native observer/provider adapter research; no arbitrary app inspection assumption
donor_repositories.vaultos: local import, indexing, backup and data integrity

product_surfaces.native_browser: A complete human-usable browser that is also a safe structured DOM observation surface; not capture-only.
product_surfaces.model_hub: A rich data-driven catalogue and lifecycle manager; model families, immutable artifacts, runtime adapters and device-readiness are separate records.
product_surfaces.native_ux: Use Memo-1/Memo-2 as audited inspiration only. Build and test Locco-specific alternatives; do not copy-paste screens, navigation, themes or components.
product_surfaces.authentication: Memo-2 sign-in failure is an unresolved user-reported regression. Classify and reproduce the exact sign-in surface before assigning a cause. Keep website sessions, OAuth account connections and model/API credentials distinct.
product_surfaces.task_composition: No hardcoded per-use-case workflows in the core planner. Compose unfamiliar tasks from reusable, versioned, typed components with deterministic policy and verification.
